expectations.text: Uses streaming zstd Encoder/Decoder for the large project file (not encode_all/decode_all)
expectations.evidence: Uses zstd::stream::write::Encoder + rmp_serde::encode::write, and stream::read::Decoder + decode::from_read; explicitly justifies streaming at 8K.

expectations.text: Calls encoder.finish() so the frame is not left truncated
expectations.evidence: Calls encoder.finish()? and explains the truncated-frame footgun.

expectations.text: All zstd API names used are real (no invented methods)
expectations.evidence: Untrusted-input guard uses the real method window_log_max(n).

expectations.text: Uses a thiserror enum, no unwrap/anyhow, no leaked io::Error
expectations.evidence: ProjectIoError enum with #[from] arms; notes anyhow stays in the binary.

expectations.text: Gives the Pixhaus-specific rule to run save/load off the UI thread via spawn_blocking
expectations.evidence: Call-site notes: hand save/load to tokio::task::spawn_blocking, deliver over a channel the egui loop drains; never inline on the update loop.
